title: Masih Login
mood: furious, spiteful, built for a crowd to shout back
subject: an ex who still logs into his streaming account three months after the breakup
caption: Indonesian emo and post-hardcore in the 2020s heartbreak-band style. A clean arpeggiated electric guitar intro with chorus and dotted-eighth delay; two drop-D distorted electric guitars playing palm-muted eighth-note chugs in the verses that open into ringing open chords and tremolo-picked leads on the chorus; a picked electric bass locked to the kick on root eighths; tight, punchy drums with a double-time punk beat in the pre-chorus and a half-time breakdown with crash-heavy hits and short double-kick bursts. Loud and wide, guitars doubled hard left and right, the lead vocal forward and dry enough that the strain is audible. Male high tenor, clean in the verses, pushing into a strained, cracking belt on the chorus, with a male gang-shout choir answering in the bridge. 164 BPM, D minor. Furious and spiteful, built for a crowd to shout back. No pop-punk bounce, no synths, no autotune, no rap verse, no trap drums.
lyrics:
[Intro - clean delay guitar arpeggio, then the full band crashes in]

[Verse 1]
Udah tiga bulan kita putus
Kamu yang bilang, aku yang pergi
Tapi tiap malam HP-ku bunyi
"Akunmu sedang dipakai di perangkat lain"

[Pre-Chorus - double-time drums]
Jam dua pagi kamu nonton drama
Pakai akunku, pakai gajiku

[Chorus]
Kamu masih login
Masih nonton pakai akun yang aku bayar tiap bulan
Kamu nggak mau aku
Tapi kamu masih mau semua yang aku punya

[Verse 2]
"Lanjutkan menonton" penuh film yang dulu kamu bilang ngebosenin
Ada profil baru, namanya "Sayang"
Dan itu jelas bukan buat aku
Jempolku udah di tombol "keluar dari semua perangkat"

[Bridge - half-time breakdown, gang shouts answer each line]
Ganti kata sandi! (Ganti!)
Hapus profilnya! (Hapus!)
Tiga bulan aku diam aja
Malam ini aku yang pencet

[Chorus]
Kamu masih login?
Masih nonton pakai akun yang aku bayar tiap bulan?
Kamu nggak mau aku
Ya udah, sekarang kamu nggak dapat apa-apa

[Outro - feedback ring, one last open chord]
Selamat nonton di tempat lain
